Rive web runtime, copied unchanged from the npm package `@rive-app/canvas-lite` 2.49.0 (`rive.js`, `rive.wasm`,
`rive_fallback.wasm`). MIT licensed, see LICENSE. It is bundled here so the app never loads it from a CDN
(unreliable in mainland China, and the Android app works offline). public/pet-rive.js points the runtime at these files.
